crossRefs.note: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.
Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.
He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.
The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.
Then justice will dwell in the wilderness; and righteousness will remain in the fruitful field.
The work of righteousness will be peace, and the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever.
Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap according to kindness. Break up your fallow ground; for it is time to seek…
Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.
He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life; that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice…
being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of…
Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.

translations.web: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
translations.bsb: Peacemakers who sow in peace reap the fruit of righteousness.
translations.kjv: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace.
translations.asv: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace for them that make peace.
